description.value: Ninja Bubble Tea is a handcrafted bubble tea and Asian fusion café founded in 2013, now operating three locations across BC's Lower Mainland. The menu spans classic tapioca milk teas, artisanal designer teas, fresh poke bowls, Filipino halo-halo shaved ice, and comfort food items like mac and cheese. The New Westminster location sits inside the Rivermarket complex on Quayside Drive.

address.value: Unit 131 - 810 Quayside Dr Rivermarket, New Westminster, BC V3M 6B9

The website is active (© 2025), lists online ordering for pickup or delivery, and describes a café with bubble tea, poke bowls, and Asian fusion — no bike-specific amenities (rack, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. The OSM 'community' metadata field reads 'North Vancouver', which conflicts with all address and coordinate evidence pointing to New Westminster.
